_note: Per-house anchor overrides. Anything omitted falls back to DEFAULT_ANCHORS in core/scene.ts, so a house only declares what its floor plan actually moves.
_why: Anchors are fractions of the house rect, which makes them survive scaling but NOT a different floor plan. A driveway on the left, a walk that reaches the sidewalk, a deeper setback — each moves the points where props are allowed to stand. Without overrides every house would have to share one layout, which also lets a player pattern-match on screen position instead of reading the lot.
_check: core/scene.ts declares what surface each anchor must sit on, and the validator samples the house art at every anchor a lot uses. A driveway anchor on grass fails the build rather than showing up as a truck parked on a lawn.
